_comment: Reviewed tracked expectations for the Cloud #106 reconciliation. Supabase expectations are derived from supabase/migrations/*.sql; only Cloud Run / IAM posture that the repository cannot otherwise derive lives here. Every field is either explicitly pinned or null (unpinned). A null field is reported by the comparator as an observation to reconcile against #106, never as agreement.

cloud_run.ingress_note: The deploy workflow does not pin --ingress today. ingress_allowed encodes the hardened posture (internal or behind the load balancer). The owner reconciles the live value against #106; any value outside ingress_allowed is drift.
